description: Bay Output: a receiver that carries the eight signals of one Bay Input module anywhere in the patch, with no cable and no sample delay

outputs.text: Carries the port of the same number on the linked Bay Input; monophonic 0V while no source is linked or that source port is unpatched

notes: every output stays at monophonic 0V until a Bay Input is picked in Bay Output source
menu: Bay Output source — picks which Bay Input this module receives from, each listed by its name and module id, or None
Bay Output name — a text field naming this module; the name is drawn at the top of the panel
Enable 0 channel output — gives an unlinked or unpatched port a cable of no channels, which a destination treats as no cable rather than as 0V
